issue.body:
Hi,
when using https://www.starlette.io/config/ , if we put 
```
VAR = 'value'   # this var is use for ....
```
we get error related to the expected role of the var.

For example in my case 
```
  File "app.py", line 292, in <module>
    Mount('/files', StaticFiles(directory=settings('JOPLIN_RESOURCES'))),
  File "[...]/lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/staticfiles.py", line 55, in __init__
    raise RuntimeError(f"Directory '{directory}' does not exist")
RuntimeError: Directory '/home/foxmask/.config/joplin-desktop/resources/'   # path to get the joplin `resources` to be able to display them' does not exist
```
or if that was for a HTTP port :
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 303, in <module>
    uvicorn.run(main_app, host='0.0.0.0', port=settings('HTTP_PORT', cast=int, default=8001))
  File "[...]lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/config.py", line 59, in __call__
    return self.get(key, cast, default)
  File "[...]lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/config.py", line 69, in get
    return self._perform_cast(key, value, cast)
  File "[...]lib/python3.7/site-packages/starlette/config.py", line 103, in _perform_cast
    f"Config '{key}' has value '{value}'. Not a valid {cast.__name__}."
ValueError: Config 'HTTP_PORT' has value '8001   # listen port number'. Not a valid int.
```
issue.title: starlette should ignore "inline" comment in env file
